name: logistics-map
description: Logistics & delivery location map for Tashkent — Express/MongoDB API with a Next.js dashboard.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names db,api,web --prefix-colors gray,green,blue "npm run db:start" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors green,blue "npm run start -w backend" "npm run start -w frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
